subject: Step2 request: let tile-fetch (LD_TILE) draws batch - 2-line hunk in your compositor_submit.inc
body: Bridge side done (uncommitted): batch_compatible now accepts TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_TILE_ATTACHMENT (n2r still requires TILE_FETCH program + no memory); memory ATTACHMENT (in-place fetch) and target-as-texture still refuse (they would miss earlier draws of the job). New bridge test: preload+2 tile-fetch draws -> one job, chain 4; tile binding without LD_TILE program refused. Requested hunk in tegu_jm_batch_draw_reason (your file, please apply or ACK me to apply): (1) delete line 'if(tegu_generic_job_shader(j)->flags&TEGU_GENERIC_SHADER_TILE_FETCH)return TEGU_JM_BREAK_READS;' (2) change 'if(kind==TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_ATTACHMENT||kind==TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_TILE_ATTACHMENT)return TEGU_JM_BREAK_READS;' to 'if(kind==TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_ATTACHMENT)return TEGU_JM_BREAK_READS;'. Effect only when tile variants exist, i.e. frontend built with -DTEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT (not in the device build today; R210 tegu probe passed LD_TILE readback, 8 feedback draws one pass, but not on this device). Root: enabling TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT for a device A/B is a build-flag decision; it also removes the 11 MB CLEAR+fetch snapshot because the tile already holds the clear colour.
